create_scalar_feature: create a Scalar feature with a specified dtype such as np.int64 or np.float32
create_scalar_with_doc: create a Scalar feature with a dtype and an optional docstring description
build_scalar_from_json: build a Scalar feature from a feature_pb2.TensorFeature protobuf message
test_scalar_dtype: test the Scalar class initializes with shape=() and the given dtype
review_scalar_inheritance: review the Scalar class inheriting from tensor_feature.Tensor with shape=()
